run_preprocess_meshes: run the preprocess_data script to preprocess 3D mesh data from a source directory into SDF samples
run_surface_sampling: run the preprocess_data script with surface sampling to produce mesh surface samples for evaluation
filter_classes_glob: filter a list of class names using glob patterns to match shape categories
filter_classes_regex: filter a list of class names using regex patterns to match shape categories
append_data_source_map: append a data source entry to the JSON data source map file for tracking sources
